# 7. Siderophore-associated patterns across the field chronosequence

## 7.1 FeGenie siderophore-associated genes

```{r field-fegenie-genes}
# DNA-scaled
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)


# 1. Paths


fegenie_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-isolation", "strain", "fegenie_summary", "independent315_summary")
out_dir  <- file.path(fegenie_dir, "figures")

dir.create(
  out_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

master_file <- file.path(
  fegenie_dir,
  "FeGenie_independent315_sample_master.tsv"
)

rpkm_file <- file.path(
  fegenie_dir,
  "FeGenie_independent315_centroid_RPKM_matrix.tsv"
)

family_file <- file.path(
  fegenie_dir,
  "FeGenie_centroid_to_family.tsv"
)

# 2. Metadata


metadata <- read.table(
  file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-isolation", "strain", "metadata.txt"),
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

metadata <- as_tibble(metadata[, 1:4])

names(metadata) <- c(
  "SeqID",
  "DNA",
  "Group_raw",
  "Type"
)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    SeqID = as.character(SeqID),
    DNA = as.numeric(DNA),
    Type = trimws(Type),
    Group_numeric = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(Group_raw)
    ),
    Analysis_group = case_when(
      Type == "SD" ~ "SD",
      Type == "SI" &
        Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17) ~
        as.character(Group_numeric),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Analysis_group = factor(
      Analysis_group,
      levels = c("SD", "11", "12", "14", "15", "17")
    ),
    plot_x = if_else(
      Type == "SD",
      10,
      Group_numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  )

# 3. Sample-level results


master <- read.delim(
  master_file,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble()

names(master)[1] <- "sample"

master <- master %>%
  mutate(
    sample = as.character(sample),
    SeqID = str_extract(sample, "^[0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata,
    by = "SeqID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_RPKM = as.numeric(
      siderophore_total_RPKM
    ),
    family_richness = as.numeric(
      siderophore_detected_HMM_richness
    ),
    
    # Scale relative gene abundance by DNA concentration
    DNA_scaled_total_RPKM = total_RPKM * DNA,
    
    # Response used for statistical analysis and plotting
    abundance_value = asinh(
      DNA_scaled_total_RPKM
    )
  )


# 4. Centroid RPKM and family classification

centroid_RPKM <- read.delim(
  rpkm_file,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble()

names(centroid_RPKM)[1] <- "sample"

family_map <- read.delim(
  family_file,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble()

names(family_map)[1:2] <- c(
  "centroid",
  "gene_family"
)

family_map <- family_map %>%
  mutate(
    gene_family = str_remove(
      gene_family,
      "-family-siderophore-synthesis$"
    ),
    synthesis_system = case_when(
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Pvd") ~
        "Pyoverdine-associated synthesis",
      
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Pch") ~
        "Pyochelin-associated synthesis",
      
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Pvs") ~
        "Vibrioferrin-associated synthesis",
      
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Rhb") ~
        "Rhizobactin-associated synthesis",
      
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Iuc") ~
        "Aerobactin-associated synthesis",
      
      TRUE ~
        "Other siderophore synthesis systems"
    )
  )

centroid_names <- intersect(
  names(centroid_RPKM),
  family_map$centroid
)

cat(
  "Matched reference genes:",
  length(centroid_names),
  "\n"
)


# 5. Sum RPKM by siderophore synthesis system


system_RPKM <- centroid_RPKM %>%
  select(
    sample,
    all_of(centroid_names)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(centroid_names),
    names_to = "centroid",
    values_to = "RPKM"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    RPKM = replace_na(
      as.numeric(RPKM),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    family_map %>%
      select(
        centroid,
        synthesis_system
      ),
    by = "centroid"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    sample,
    synthesis_system
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    system_RPKM = sum(
      RPKM,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

system_names <- sort(
  unique(family_map$synthesis_system)
)

system_RPKM <- system_RPKM %>%
  complete(
    sample = unique(master$sample),
    synthesis_system = system_names,
    fill = list(system_RPKM = 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    master %>%
      select(
        sample,
        SeqID,
        DNA,
        Type,
        Analysis_group,
        Group_numeric,
        plot_x
      ),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Scale relative gene abundance by DNA concentration
    DNA_scaled_system_RPKM = system_RPKM * DNA,
    
    # Response used for statistical analysis and plotting
    system_value = asinh(
      DNA_scaled_system_RPKM
    ),
    
    synthesis_system = factor(
      synthesis_system,
      levels = c(
        "Pyoverdine-associated synthesis",
        "Pyochelin-associated synthesis",
        "Vibrioferrin-associated synthesis",
        "Rhizobactin-associated synthesis",
        "Aerobactin-associated synthesis",
        "Other siderophore synthesis systems"
      )
    )
  )


# 6. GLM functions
#    Only SI samples from restoration years 11–17 are modeled
#    DNA is incorporated into the response and is therefore
#    not included as a model covariate.


glm_statistics <- function(data, response, metric) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Type == "SI",
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(.data[[response]])
    )
  
  model <- glm(
    reformulate(
      "Group_numeric",
      response = response
    ),
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  tidy(
    model,
    conf.int = TRUE
  ) %>%
    filter(
      term == "Group_numeric"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      metric = metric,
      n = nrow(model_data),
      GLM_beta_per_year = estimate,
      standard_error = std.error,
      confidence_interval_lower = conf.low,
      confidence_interval_upper = conf.high,
      P_value = p.value
    )
}


glm_prediction <- function(data, response) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Type == "SI",
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(.data[[response]])
    )
  
  model <- glm(
    reformulate(
      "Group_numeric",
      response = response
    ),
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  prediction_data <- tibble(
    Group_numeric = seq(
      11,
      17,
      length.out = 100
    )
  )
  
  prediction <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = prediction_data,
    se.fit = TRUE
  )
  
  prediction_data %>%
    mutate(
      fitted = as.numeric(prediction$fit),
      lower = fitted -
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit),
      upper = fitted +
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit)
    )
}


# 7. GLM statistics


overall_statistics <- bind_rows(
  glm_statistics(
    master,
    "abundance_value",
    paste(
      "DNA-scaled total siderophore",
      "biosynthesis gene abundance"
    )
  ),
  glm_statistics(
    master,
    "family_richness",
    paste(
      "Number of detected siderophore",
      "biosynthesis gene families"
    )
  )
)

system_statistics <- system_RPKM %>%
  group_by(
    synthesis_system
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ glm_statistics(
      .x,
      "system_value",
      as.character(.y$synthesis_system)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

statistics_table <- bind_rows(
  overall_statistics,
  system_statistics
) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    trend = case_when(
      GLM_beta_per_year < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      GLM_beta_per_year > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  statistics_table,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Independent315_DNA_scaled_RPKM_GLM_statistics.tsv"
  )
)

print(
  statistics_table,
  n = Inf
)

# 7. Prediction lines

abundance_prediction <- glm_prediction(
  master,
  "abundance_value"
)

richness_prediction <- glm_prediction(
  master,
  "family_richness"
)

system_prediction <- system_RPKM %>%
  group_by(
    synthesis_system
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ glm_prediction(
      .x,
      "system_value"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## 7.2 F8 DFOE-associated gene homologues

```{r field-dfoe-gene-homologues}

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)


# 1. Files

setwd(
  file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-isolation", "strain")
)

master_file <- paste0(
  "independent18_summary/",
  "DFOE_independent18_sample_master.tsv"
)

output_dir <- "independent18_summary/figures"

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# 2. Metadata

metadata <- read.table(
  "metadata.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

metadata <- as_tibble(metadata[, 1:4])

names(metadata) <- c(
  "SeqID",
  "DNA",
  "Group_raw",
  "Type"
)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    SeqID = as.character(SeqID),
    DNA = as.numeric(DNA),
    Type = trimws(Type),
    Group_numeric = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(Group_raw)
    ),
    Analysis_group = case_when(
      Type == "SD" ~ "SD",
      Type == "SI" &
        Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17) ~
        as.character(Group_numeric),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Analysis_group = factor(
      Analysis_group,
      levels = c("SD", "11", "12", "14", "15", "17")
    ),
    plot_x = if_else(
      Type == "SD",
      10,
      Group_numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  )

# 3. DFOE results

dfoe <- read.delim(
  master_file,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    sample = as.character(sample),
    SeqID = str_extract(sample, "^[0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata,
    by = "SeqID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  )


# 4. Long-format plotting data


metric_labels <- c(
  "00626_total_RPKM" =
    "ddc-like",
  
  "00627_total_RPKM" =
    "iucD-like",
  
  "00628_total_RPKM" =
    "bibC-like",
  
  "max_core3_mean_RPKM" =
    "Collinear three-gene module"
)

plot_data <- dfoe %>%
  select(
    sample,
    SeqID,
    DNA,
    Type,
    Analysis_group,
    Group_numeric,
    plot_x,
    all_of(names(metric_labels))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(names(metric_labels)),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "RPKM"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    RPKM = replace_na(
      as.numeric(RPKM),
      0
    ),
    
    # Scale relative abundance by DNA concentration
    DNA_scaled_RPKM = RPKM * DNA,
    
    # Response variable
    plot_value = asinh(
      DNA_scaled_RPKM
    ),
    
    metric_label = recode(
      metric,
      !!!metric_labels
    ),
    
    metric_label = factor(
      metric_label,
      levels = unname(metric_labels)
    )
  )



# 5. GLM
#    DNA is incorporated into the response and is therefore
#    not included as a model covariate.


fit_GLM <- function(data) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Type == "SI",
      Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17),
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(plot_value)
    )
  
  model <- glm(
    plot_value ~ Group_numeric,
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  result <- tidy(
    model,
    conf.int = TRUE
  ) %>%
    filter(
      term == "Group_numeric"
    )
  
  tibble(
    n_SI = nrow(model_data),
    GLM_beta_per_year = result$estimate,
    standard_error = result$std.error,
    confidence_interval_lower = result$conf.low,
    confidence_interval_upper = result$conf.high,
    P_value = result$p.value
  )
}

statistics_table <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(
    metric,
    metric_label
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ fit_GLM(.x)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    trend = case_when(
      GLM_beta_per_year < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      GLM_beta_per_year > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  statistics_table,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "DFOE_independent18_DNA_scaled_RPKM_GLM_statistics.tsv"
  )
)

print(
  statistics_table,
  n = Inf
)

# 6. GLM prediction lines


make_prediction <- function(data) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Type == "SI",
      Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17),
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(plot_value)
    )
  
  model <- glm(
    plot_value ~ Group_numeric,
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  prediction_data <- tibble(
    Group_numeric = seq(
      11,
      17,
      length.out = 100
    )
  )
  
  prediction <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = prediction_data,
    se.fit = TRUE
  )
  
  prediction_data %>%
    mutate(
      fitted = as.numeric(
        prediction$fit
      ),
      lower = fitted -
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit),
      upper = fitted +
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit)
    )
}

prediction_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(
    metric,
    metric_label
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ make_prediction(.x)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## 7.3 Field DFOE concentration
```{r DFOE-field-concentarion}
 library(tidyverse)
   
  
   # 1. Read data
   
   df <- read.delim("dfoe-field.txt") %>%
     mutate(
       group = factor(
         group,
         levels = c("SD", "11", "12", "14", "15", "17")
       ),
       Group_numeric = suppressWarnings(
         as.numeric(as.character(group))
       ),
       plot_x = ifelse(group == "SD", 10, Group_numeric)
     )

   # 2. Trend model: 11–17 years only
   
   si <- df %>%
     filter(group != "SD")
   
   trend_model <- lm(
     con ~ Group_numeric,
     data = si
   )
   
   trend_p <- summary(trend_model)$coefficients[
     "Group_numeric", "Pr(>|t|)"
   ]
   
   trend_label <- ifelse(
     trend_p > 0.05,
     "Linear trend, italic(P) > 0.05",
     paste0(
       "Linear trend, italic(P) == ",
       formatC(trend_p, format = "e", digits = 2)
     )
   )
   
   # 3. Fitted trend and 95% confidence interval
   
   trend_prediction <- tibble(
     Group_numeric = seq(11, 17, length.out = 200)
   )
   
   trend_prediction <- bind_cols(
     trend_prediction,
     as_tibble(
       predict(
         trend_model,
         newdata = trend_prediction,
         interval = "confidence"
       )
     )
   ) %>%
     rename(
       fitted = fit,
       lower = lwr,
       upper = upr
     )
   
 
   # 4. Colors and theme
   
   group_colors <- c(
     "SD" = "#F4A64E",
     "11" = "#E7E88E",
     "12" = "#C9D579",
     "14" = "#A5B86E",
     "15" = "#7E9A59",
     "17" = "#526F43"
   )
   
   trend_color <- "#0d47a1"
   
   plot_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 16) +

       axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
       axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
       axis.line = element_blank(),
       panel.border = element_rect(

       ),
       plot.title = element_text(

       ),
       legend.position = "none"
     )
   
   x_scale <- scale_x_continuous(
     breaks = c(10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 17),
     labels = c("SD", "11", "12", "14", "15", "17"),
     limits = c(9.4, 17.4)
   )
   

   # 5. Plot
   
   p <- ggplot(
     df,
     aes(plot_x, con)
   ) +
     geom_boxplot(
       aes(
         group = group,

       ),

     ) +

       data = trend_prediction,

         x = Group_numeric,

       ),
       inherit.aes = FALSE,
       color = trend_color,

     ) +
     # annotate(
     #   "text",
     #   x = 10.7,
     #   y = Inf,
     #   label = trend_label,
     #   parse = TRUE,
     #   hjust = 0,
     #   vjust = 1.4,
     #   size = 4
     # ) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
     scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
     x_scale +
     labs(
       x = "Restoration year",
       y = "DFOE concentration"
     ) +
     plot_theme 
   
   p
   
   
   
   ggsave(filename = file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-isolation", "strain", "siderophore-field.pdf"),
          width = 4, height = 3) 
   
   
   
   # 仅分析11–17年的恢复趋势
   si <- df %>% filter(group != "SD")
   
   # 1. 线性趋势
   fit <- lm(con ~ year, data = si)
   fit_sum <- summary(fit)$coefficients
   
   trend_result <- tibble(
     test = "Linear trend (11–17 years)",
     estimate_per_year = fit_sum["year", "Estimate"],
     standard_error = fit_sum["year", "Std. Error"],
     p_value = fit_sum["year", "Pr(>|t|)"]
   )
   
   trend_result
   # 2. Spearman趋势
   sp <- cor.test(si$year, si$con, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
   
   spearman_result <- tibble(
     test = "Spearman trend (11–17 years)",
     estimate_per_year = unname(sp$estimate),
     standard_error = NA_real_,
     p_value = sp$p.value
   )
   
   # 3. 11–17年各组总体差异
   kw <- kruskal.test(con ~ group, data = si)
   
   kruskal_result <- tibble(
     test = "Kruskal–Wallis test (11–17 years)",
     estimate_per_year = NA_real_,
     standard_error = NA_real_,
     p_value = kw$p.value
   )
   
   statistics_table <- bind_rows(
     trend_result,
     spearman_result,
     kruskal_result
   ) %>%
     mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
   
   print(statistics_table)
   write_tsv(statistics_table, "DFOE_field_statistics.tsv")
   
   # 4. 各恢复年份两两比较
   pairwise_result <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
     x = si$con,
     g = si$group,
     p.adjust.method = "BH",
     exact = FALSE
   )
   
   pairwise_table <- as.data.frame(as.table(pairwise_result$p.value)) %>%
     filter(!is.na(Freq)) %>%
     rename(
       group_1 = Var1,
       group_2 = Var2,
       adjusted_p_value = Freq
     )
   
   print(pairwise_table)
   write_tsv(pairwise_table, "DFOE_field_pairwise_comparisons.tsv")
   
   # 5. SD与全部恢复样本比较
   sd_si <- wilcox.test(
     con ~ ifelse(group == "SD", "SD", "Restored"),
     data = df,
     exact = FALSE
   )
   
   sd_comparison <- tibble(
     comparison = "SD vs restored sites",
     p_value = sd_si$p.value
   )
   
   print(sd_comparison)
   write_tsv(sd_comparison, "DFOE_SD_vs_restored.tsv")
```

## 7.4 Field-extractable elements

```{r Field-extractable elements}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)


# 1. Files and parameters


input_file <- file.path(
  data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-84-2020",
  "dtpa-field.txt"
)

output_dir <- file.path(
  data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-84-2020",
  "dtpa-field-figures"
)

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

group_levels <- c(
  "SD", "11", "12", "14", "15", "17"
)

element_cols <- c(
  "Al", "Ca", "Cd", "Cr", "Cu", "Fe",
  "K", "Mg", "Mn", "Mo", "Na", "Ni",
  "P", "Pb", "S", "Sb", "Sn", "Zn"
)
 
element_cols <- c(
  "Fe", "Al", "Mn",
  "Ca", "Mg", "K", "Na",
  "P", "S",
  "Zn", "Cu", "Ni", "Mo", "Cr",
  "Cd", "Pb", "Sb", "Sn"
)


# 2. Read data

mydata <- read.delim(
  input_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"
)

element_cols <- intersect(
  element_cols,
  colnames(mydata)
)

cat(
  "Elements included:",
  paste(element_cols, collapse = ", "),
  "\n"
)

mydata2 <- mydata %>%
  mutate(
    group = trimws(as.character(group)),
    across(
      all_of(element_cols),
      as.numeric
    )
  )


# 3. Blank correction

blank_data <- mydata2 %>%
  filter(
    toupper(group) == "BLANK"
  )

if (nrow(blank_data) == 0) {
  stop("No BLANK samples were found in the group column.")
}

blank_mean <- blank_data %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(element_cols),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

df_blank_corrected <- mydata2 %>%
  filter(
    toupper(group) != "BLANK"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(element_cols),
      ~ .x - blank_mean[[cur_column()]]
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(element_cols),
      ~ case_when(
        is.na(.x) ~ NA_real_,
        .x < 0 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ .x
      )
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  df_blank_corrected,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "dtpa-field-blank-corrected.tsv"
  )
)


# 4. Long-format plotting data


df_long <- df_blank_corrected %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = group_levels
    ),
    Group_numeric = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(group))
    ),
    plot_x = if_else(
      as.character(group) == "SD",
      10,
      Group_numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(group)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(element_cols),
    names_to = "element",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.numeric(value),
    element = factor(
      element,
      levels = element_cols
    )
  )

# 5. GLM statistics
#    Only restoration years 11–17 are modeled.
#    SD is displayed but is not included in the GLM.


fit_GLM <- function(data) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17),
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(value)
    )
  
  if (
    nrow(model_data) < 3 ||
    n_distinct(model_data$Group_numeric) < 2
  ) {
    return(
      tibble(
        n_SI = nrow(model_data),
        GLM_beta_per_year = NA_real_,
        standard_error = NA_real_,
        confidence_interval_lower = NA_real_,
        confidence_interval_upper = NA_real_,
        P_value = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }
  
  model <- glm(
    value ~ Group_numeric,
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  result <- tidy(
    model,
    conf.int = TRUE
  ) %>%
    filter(
      term == "Group_numeric"
    )
  
  tibble(
    n_SI = nrow(model_data),
    GLM_beta_per_year = result$estimate,
    standard_error = result$std.error,
    confidence_interval_lower = result$conf.low,
    confidence_interval_upper = result$conf.high,
    P_value = result$p.value
  )
}

statistics_table <- df_long %>%
  group_by(
    element
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ fit_GLM(.x)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    trend = case_when(
      GLM_beta_per_year < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      GLM_beta_per_year > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  statistics_table,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "DTPA_elements_GLM_statistics.tsv"
  )
)

print(
  statistics_table,
  n = Inf
)


# 6. GLM prediction lines and 95% confidence intervals


make_prediction <- function(data) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17),
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(value)
    )
  
  if (
    nrow(model_data) < 3 ||
    n_distinct(model_data$Group_numeric) < 2
  ) {
    return(
      tibble(
        Group_numeric = numeric(),
        fitted = numeric(),
        lower = numeric(),
        upper = numeric()
      )
    )
  }
  
  model <- glm(
    value ~ Group_numeric,
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  prediction_data <- tibble(
    Group_numeric = seq(
      11,
      17,
      length.out = 100
    )
  )
  
  prediction <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = prediction_data,
    se.fit = TRUE,
    type = "response"
  )
  
  prediction_data %>%
    mutate(
      fitted = as.numeric(
        prediction$fit
      ),
      lower = fitted -
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit),
      upper = fitted +
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit)
    )
}

prediction_data <- df_long %>%
  group_by(
    element
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ make_prediction(.x)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# 7. Plot colors and theme


group_colors <- c(
  "SD" = "#F4A64E",
  "11" = "#E7E88E",
  "12" = "#C9D579",
  "14" = "#A5B86E",
  "15" = "#7E9A59",
  "17" = "#526F43"
)

trend_color <- "#0d47a1"

plot_theme <- theme_classic(
  base_size = 14
) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "#777777",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 11,
      margin = margin(
        3, 2, 3, 2
      )
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing = unit(
      0.8,
      "lines"
    )
  )



# 7. Plot


DTPA_figure <- ggplot(
  df_long,
  aes(
    x = plot_x,
    y = value
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      group = group,
      fill = group
    ),
    width = 0.65,

  ) +
```

## 9.3 Particle-size redistribution

```{r validation-particle-size}
# indoor
  library(tidyverse)
 df <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "PND", "p3-os-wt.txt"),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                   header = T, sep = "\t")
# field
  df <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "PND", "outdoor-os-wt-p3.txt"),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                   header = T, sep = "\t")
  

 
  
  #  可选：是否用“数目权重” 
  use_number_weighted <- FALSE  # 想用数目权重就设 TRUE
  
  plot_delta_p <- function(df, group_sel, use_number_weighted = FALSE) {
    diam_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("sample","week","group"))
    
    # 长表
    long <- df %>%
      filter(group == group_sel, week %in% c(0, 12)) %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(diam_cols), names_to = "diameter", values_to = "p3") %>%
      mutate(diameter = as.numeric(diameter)) %>%
      arrange(sample, week, diameter)
    
    # 计算“每周×直径” 的平均频率 (%)
    if (!use_number_weighted) {
      # 用原始 p3 直接归一化成频率(%)
      df_freq <- long %>%
        group_by(week, diameter) %>%
        summarise(mean_value = mean(p3), .groups = "drop") %>%
        group_by(week) %>%
        mutate(freq_percent = 100 * mean_value / sum(mean_value)) %>%
        ungroup()
    } else {
      # 把 p3 近似视作面积或体积频率；换算成“数目权重”：pN ∝ p3 / d^2
      d <- sort(unique(long$diameter))
      d2 <- d^2
      df_freq <- long %>%
        group_by(sample, week) %>%
        group_modify(~{
          p_area <- .x$p3
          p_num  <- (p_area / (d2 + 1e-12))
          p_num  <- 100 * p_num / sum(p_num)
          tibble(diameter = d, freq_percent = p_num)
        }) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        group_by(week, diameter) %>%
        summarise(freq_percent = mean(freq_percent), .groups = "drop")
    }
    
    # 宽表并计算 Δp(d) = 12w - 0w
    dp <- df_freq %>%
      select(week, diameter, freq_percent) %>%
      mutate(week = as.character(week)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = week, values_from = freq_percent, names_prefix = "w") %>%
      arrange(diameter) %>%
      mutate(delta_p = w12 - w0)
    
    # 画“差值曲线”
    ggplot(dp, aes(diameter, delta_p)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "#D1495B") +
      # 如需对数轴就打开下一行
      # scale_x_log10()
      labs(x = "Particle diameter (nm)",
           y = expression(Delta*p~"(12 w - 0 w, %)"),
           title = paste0("Δp(d) — ", toupper(group_sel),
                          ifelse(use_number_weighted, " (Number-weighted)", ""))) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 16)
  }
  
  # 直接画 OE 与 WT 两条差值曲线 
  p_oe <- plot_delta_p(df, "oe", use_number_weighted)
  p_wt <- plot_delta_p(df, "wt", use_number_weighted)
  
  print(p_oe)
  print(p_wt)
  
  # 如要保存：
  # ggsave("delta_p_oe.png", p_oe, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  # ggsave("delta_p_wt.png", p_wt, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  
 
  library(tidyverse)
  
  # 公用：列名 / 直径网格 
  diam_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("sample","week","group"))
  dgrid <- as.numeric(diam_cols)
  
  # 每样本频率（%）
  sample_freq <- function(df, group_sel, wk){
    df %>% filter(group==group_sel, week==wk) %>%
      select(all_of(diam_cols)) %>% as.matrix() %>%
      { 100 * . / rowSums(.) }
  }
  
  # 计算：原始折线 + bootstrap CI + p 值 + FDR
  boot_delta_ci_p <- function(df, group_sel, B = 4000, alpha = 0.05){
    X0  <- sample_freq(df, group_sel, 0);   n0  <- nrow(X0)
    X12 <- sample_freq(df, group_sel, 12);  n12 <- nrow(X12)
    
    # 原始折线（不平滑）
    raw <- tibble(diam = dgrid, delta_raw = colMeans(X12) - colMeans(X0))
    
    # bootstrap
    set.seed(1)
    deltas <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(B, ncol(X0)))
    for(b in seq_len(B)){
      m0  <- colMeans(X0 [sample(n0,  n0,  replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE])
      m12 <- colMeans(X12[sample(n12, n12, replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE])
      deltas[b, ] <- m12 - m0
    }
    
    mu <- colMeans(deltas)
    lo <- apply(deltas, 2, quantile, probs = alpha/2)
    hi <- apply(deltas, 2, quantile, probs = 1 - alpha/2)
    
    # 双侧 p 值：p = 2 * min(Pr[Δ>=0], Pr[Δ<=0])
    p_two <- apply(deltas, 2, function(v) 2 * min(mean(v >= 0), mean(v <= 0)))
    padj  <- p.adjust(p_two, method = "BH")
    
    ci <- tibble(
      diam = dgrid, mu = mu, lo = lo, hi = hi,
      p = p_two, padj = padj,
      sig_fdr = padj < 0.05              # 只标 FDR<0.05 的点
    )
    list(raw = raw, ci = ci)
  }
  
  # 画图：无黄色带，限制 x 到 1600；可选对数轴；自定义颜色
  plot_delta_ci <- function(df, group_sel, line_col = "#D1495B",
                            xmax = 1600, log_x = FALSE, title = ""){
    comp <- boot_delta_ci_p(df, group_sel, B = 4000)
    raw  <- comp$raw
    ci   <- comp$ci
    
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_ribbon(data = ci, aes(x = diam, ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                  fill = "#B0B0B0", alpha = .20) +
      geom_line(data = raw, aes(diam, delta_raw),
                color = line_col, linewidth = 1.05) +
      geom_point(data = subset(ci, sig_fdr), aes(diam, mu),
                 color = "black", size = 1.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = .3) +
      labs(x = "Particle diameter (µm)",
           y = expression(Delta*p~"(d84 − d0, %)"),
           title = title) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(dgrid), xmax)) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black")
      )
    
    if (log_x) p <- p + scale_x_log10(limits = c(min(dgrid), xmax))
    p
  }
  
  # 出图（不同颜色）
  p_oe <- plot_delta_ci(df, "oe", line_col = "#4F8FB3",
                        xmax = 1600, log_x = FALSE,
                        title = "OE — Δp(d) with bootstrap 95% CI (FDR points)")
  p_wt <- plot_delta_ci(df, "wt", line_col = "#7FA35A",
                        xmax = 1600, log_x = FALSE,
                        title = "WT — Δp(d) with bootstrap 95% CI (FDR points)")
  
  print(p_oe)
  print(p_wt)
  
  library(patchwork)
  p_oe + p_wt + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 1))
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "PND", "outdoor-wt-0-12-T.pdf"), width = 5, height = 3)
  
  
  box_colors   <- c(
    "NC" = "#6E6E6E",   # 深灰
    "KO" = "#C9A227",   # 暗金
    "WT" = "#7FA35A",   # 橄榄绿
    "OS" = "#6FA8C9"    # 灰蓝
  )
  
  line_colors <- c(
    "NC" = "#4A4A4A",
    "KO" = "#B58900",
    "WT" = "#6B8E23",
    "OS" = "#4F8FB3"
  )
  
  
  library(tidyverse)
  
  # —— 保持已有的函数：sample_freq、boot_delta_ci_p（含 FDR 计算） ——
  # 若已在环境中，无需重复定义
  
  # 1) 计算 OE / WT 的原始折线 + CI + FDR，并打上 group 标记

  comp_wt <- boot_delta_ci_p(df, "wt", B = 4000)

  line_cols <- c("OE" = "#4F8FB3", "WT" = "#7FA35A")

  # 画图（注意 facet_wrap 使用同一个因子）
  p_combined <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = ci_df,
                aes(x = diam, ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                fill = "#B0B0B0", alpha = .20) +

              aes(diam, delta_raw, color = group),
              linewidth = 1.05) +

               aes(diam, mu),
               color = "black", size = 1.6) +

    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(add = c(20, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(dgrid), 1300)) +
    labs(x = "Particle diameter (µm)",
         y = expression(Delta*p~"(d84 − d0, %)")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),

    )
  
  print(p_combined)

  # comp_oe <- boot_delta_ci_p(df, "oe"); write.csv(comp_oe$ci, "OE_delta_p_FDR.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  # comp_wt <- boot_delta_ci_p(df, "wt"); write.csv(comp_wt$ci, "WT_delta_p_FDR.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  
  
  
 #统计
  # 安装/载入
  # install.packages("mgcv")   # 通常自带，如缺再装
  library(tidyverse)
  library(mgcv)
  
  # 1) 组织成“样本×粒径”的频率长表 
  diam_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("sample","week","group"))
  dgrid <- as.numeric(diam_cols)
  
  make_long_freq <- function(df, group_sel){
    df %>%
      filter(group == group_sel, week %in% c(0,12)) %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(diam_cols), names_to="diam", values_to="val") %>%
      mutate(diam = as.numeric(diam)) %>%
      group_by(sample, week) %>%
      mutate(freq = 100 * val / sum(val)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(logd = log10(diam),
             weekf = factor(week, levels=c(0,12)))
  }
  
  dat_oe <- make_long_freq(df, "oe")
  dat_wt <- make_long_freq(df, "wt")
  
  # 2) 拟合 GAM 并做“形状是否不同”的整体检验 
  fit_compare <- function(dat, k = 20){
    # 共同曲线（周之间仅截距差异）
    m_common <- gam(freq ~ weekf + s(logd, k=k, bs="cr"),
                    data = dat, method = "REML")
    # 分别曲线（0w/12w 各一条光滑）= factor-smooth interaction
    m_sep    <- gam(freq ~ weekf + s(logd, by = weekf, k=k, bs="cr"),
                    data = dat, method = "REML")
    # 比较：分开曲线是否显著优于共同曲线（形状不同）
    cmp <- anova(m_common, m_sep, test = "Chisq")
    list(m_common=m_common, m_sep=m_sep, cmp=cmp)
  }
  
  res_oe <- fit_compare(dat_oe, k=25)
  res_wt <- fit_compare(dat_wt, k=25)
  
  res_oe$cmp   # 查看 OE 的模型比较（看 Pr(>Chi)）
  res_wt$cmp   # 查看 WT 的模型比较
```

```{r validation-persistence-viability}
# Boxplot function

make_boxplot <- function(dat, title, ylab,
                         y_add_lower = 0.08,
                         y_add_upper = 0.18) {
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(day = factor(day, levels = sort(unique(day))))
  
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = day, y = value, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(color = group),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.78),
      width = 0.60,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(group = interaction(day, group)),
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.08,
        dodge.width = 0.78
      ),
      shape = 21,
      size = 1.2,
      stroke = 0.3,
      fill = "#5D6568",
      color = "#363F43",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = box_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = line_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0), add = c(y_add_lower, y_add_upper))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = ylab
    ) +
    theme_my
}

library(readr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(tibble)


# Read data

df <- read.delim(
  file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "PMA", "indoor", "copies-indoor.txt"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"
)

df <- read.delim(
  file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "PMA", "field", "copies-field.txt"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"
)



# Prepare data

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    group = recode(group, "OE" = "OS"),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")),
    day_num = as.numeric(as.character(day)),
    day = factor(day_num, levels = c(0, 42, 84)),
    rep_id = interaction(group, sample_id, drop = TRUE)
  )


# Build variables for 9 panels

df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Row 1: bacterial
    total_bacterial = log10(`16s-no-pma` + 1),
    viable_bacterial = log10(`16s-pma` + 1),
    bacterial_live_logratio =
      log10(`16s-pma` + 1) - log10(`16s-no-pma` + 1),
    
    # Row 2: inoculant
    total_inoculant = log10(`N9-S-no-pma` + 1),
    viable_inoculant = log10(`N9-S-pma` + 1),
    inoculant_live_logratio =
      log10(`N9-S-pma` + 1) - log10(`N9-S-no-pma` + 1),
    
    # Row 3: BibC-like
    total_bibc = log10(`BibC-like-no-pma` + 1),
    viable_bibc = log10(`BibC-like-pma` + 1),
    bibc_live_logratio =
      log10(`BibC-like-pma` + 1) - log10(`BibC-like-no-pma` + 1)
  )


# Analysis settings matching visualization

analysis_list <- list(
  
  # Row 1
  # p1: 0, 42, 84; 4 groups
  total_bacterial = list(
    var = "total_bacterial",
    days = c("0", "42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p2: 0, 42, 84; 4 groups
  viable_bacterial = list(
    var = "viable_bacterial",
    days = c("0", "42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p3: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  bacterial_live_logratio = list(
    var = "bacterial_live_logratio",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # Row 2
  # p4: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  total_inoculant = list(
    var = "total_inoculant",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p5: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  viable_inoculant = list(
    var = "viable_inoculant",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p6: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  inoculant_live_logratio = list(
    var = "inoculant_live_logratio",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # Row 3
  # p7: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  total_bibc = list(
    var = "total_bibc",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p8: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  viable_bibc = list(
    var = "viable_bibc",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p9: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  bibc_live_logratio = list(
    var = "bibc_live_logratio",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  )
)


# LMM function

run_lmm <- function(dat, response_var, keep_days, keep_groups) {
  
  subdat <- dat %>%
    filter(day %in% keep_days, group %in% keep_groups) %>%
    select(group, day, rep_id, all_of(response_var)) %>%
    rename(y = all_of(response_var)) %>%
    filter(is.finite(y), !is.na(y)) %>%
    droplevels() %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(group, levels = keep_groups),
      day = factor(day, levels = keep_days),
      rep_id = factor(rep_id)
    )
  
  fit <- lmer(
    y ~ group * day + (1 | rep_id),
    data = subdat,
    REML = FALSE
  )
  
  anova_tab <- anova(fit, type = 3) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term")
  
  emm_all <- emmeans(fit, ~ group * day) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  group_by_day <- emmeans(fit, ~ group | day) %>%
    pairs(adjust = "BH") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  day_by_group <- emmeans(fit, ~ day | group) %>%
    pairs(adjust = "BH") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  list(
    data = subdat,
    fit = fit,
    anova = anova_tab,
    emm = emm_all,
    group_by_day = group_by_day,
    day_by_group = day_by_group
  )
}


# Run all analyses

results <- imap(
  analysis_list,
  ~ run_lmm(
    dat = df2,
    response_var = .x$var,
    keep_days = .x$days,
    keep_groups = .x$groups
  )
)


# Combine outputs

anova_all <- imap_dfr(
  results,
  ~ mutate(.x$anova, panel = .y),
  .id = NULL
)

emm_all <- imap_dfr(
  results,
  ~ mutate(.x$emm, panel = .y),
  .id = NULL
)

group_by_day_all <- imap_dfr(
  results,
  ~ mutate(.x$group_by_day, panel = .y),
  .id = NULL
)

day_by_group_all <- imap_dfr(
  results,
  ~ mutate(.x$day_by_group, panel = .y),
  .id = NULL
)

# Significant results

anova_sig <- anova_all %>%
  filter(`Pr(>F)` < 0.05)

group_by_day_sig <- group_by_day_all %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

day_by_group_sig <- day_by_group_all %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)


# View outputs

anova_sig
group_by_day_sig
day_by_group_sig
```

```{r validation-surface-alteration}
## SEM 统计分析 
library(tidyverse)

  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"
)

names(data)


# Create biological replicate ID
# Every two consecutive ROIs within the same group = one biological replicate

df_rep <- data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(
    row_in_group = row_number(),
    replicate = ceiling(row_in_group / 2)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_local_variance = mean(Mean_local_variance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Altered_surface_fraction = mean(Altered_surface_fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    ROI_area_um2 = mean(ROI_area_um2, na.rm = TRUE),
    altered_area_um2 = mean(altered_area_um2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ROI = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = recode(
      group,
      "KO" = "ΔBibC-like",
      "OE" = "OE-BibC-like"
    ),
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c("NC", "WT", "ΔBibC-like", "OE-BibC-like")
    )
  )

df_rep

# Check n per group
df_rep %>%
  count(group)

  )
```

```{r DTPA-extractable-Fe}
library(dplyr)

   data <- read.delim(

   # 检查 sample 是否跨时间重复
   check_indoor <- indoor %>%
     group_by(sample_id) %>%
     summarise(n_day = n_distinct(day), .groups = "drop")
   
   print(check_indoor)
   
   m_dtpa <- lmer(Fe ~ group * day + (1 | sample_id), data = indoor)
   
   summary(m_dtpa)
   anova(m_dtpa)
   
   anova_dtpa <- as.data.frame(anova(m_dtpa))
   anova_dtpa$term <- rownames(anova_dtpa)
   rownames(anova_dtpa) <- NULL
   print(anova_dtpa)
   
   # 事后比较：每个 day 内比较 group
   emm_day_group <- emmeans(m_dtpa, ~ group | day)
   pair_day_group <- contrast(emm_day_group, method = "pairwise")
   
   print(emm_day_group)
   print(pair_day_group)
```

```{r validation-dtpa-iron}
    ## 统计分析 包含baseline 
   library(dplyr)
   library(FSA)
   library(multcompView)
   
   data <- read.delim(
     file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "ACBD", "indoor-abcd-plot.txt"),
     stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
     check.names = FALSE,
     header = TRUE,
     sep = "\t"
   )
   
   data <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "ACBD", "field-abcd-plot.txt"),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                      header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
   
   
   
   data$stage <- factor(
     data$stage,
     levels = c("Step 1", "Step 2", "Step 3", "Step 4")
   )
   
   data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = c("NC", "WT", "KO", "OS"))
   data$day   <- as.numeric(data$day)
   data$Fe    <- as.numeric(data$Fe)
   
   # 把 day 0 作为 Baseline 组；day 84 保留原 group
   stat_data <- data %>%
     mutate(
       stat_group = ifelse(day == 0, "Baseline", as.character(group)),
       stat_group = factor(
         stat_group,
         levels = c("Baseline", "NC", "WT", "KO", "OS")
       )
     ) %>%
     filter(day %in% c(0, 84))
   
   kw_res_list <- list()
   dunn_res_list <- list()
   letters_list <- list()
   
   for (st in levels(stat_data$stage)) {
     
     df_sub <- stat_data %>%
       filter(stage == st)
     
     # 1) Kruskal-Wallis
     kw_res <- kruskal.test(Fe ~ stat_group, data = df_sub)
     kw_res_list[[st]] <- kw_res
     
     # 2) Dunn post hoc
     dunn_res <- dunnTest(Fe ~ stat_group, data = df_sub, method = "bh")
     dunn_res_list[[st]] <- dunn_res
     
     dunn_tbl <- dunn_res$res
     
     comps <- gsub(" - ", "-", dunn_tbl$Comparison)
     pvals <- dunn_tbl$P.adj
     names(pvals) <- comps
     
     # 3) compact letters
     let <- multcompLetters(pvals)$Letters
     
     letters_df <- data.frame(
       stage = st,
       stat_group = names(let),
       letter = let,
       stringsAsFactors = FALSE
     )
     
     letters_list[[st]] <- letters_df
   }
   
   letters_df_all <- bind_rows(letters_list)
   
   kw_summary <- data.frame(
     stage = names(kw_res_list),
     statistic = sapply(kw_res_list, function(x) unname(x$statistic)),
     p_value = sapply(kw_res_list, function(x) x$p.value)
   )
   
   print(kw_summary)
   print(letters_df_all)
   
   # 输出每个 Step 的 Dunn 详细结果
   for (st in names(dunn_res_list)) {
     cat("\n====================\n")
     cat(st, "\n")
     print(dunn_res_list[[st]]$res)
   }

   library(dplyr)

   library(lmerTest)
   library(emmeans)
   
   data <- read.delim(
     file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "ACBD", "indoor-abcd-plot.txt"),

   )
   
   data <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "ACBD", "field-abcd-plot.txt"),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                      header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
   
   
   data$stage <- factor(
     data$stage,
     levels = c("Step 1", "Step 2", "Step 3", "Step 4")
   )
   
   data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS"))
   data$day   <- as.numeric(data$day)
   data$Fe    <- as.numeric(data$Fe)
   
   
   # 1. 计算每个 step 的 day 0 baseline
  
   baseline_df <- data %>%
     filter(day == 0) %>%
     group_by(stage) %>%
     summarise(
       baseline_mean = mean(Fe, na.rm = TRUE),
       .groups = "drop"
     )
   
 
   # 2. 只取 84 天，计算 log2FC
 
   plot_df <- data %>%
     filter(day == 84) %>%
     left_join(baseline_df, by = "stage") %>%
     mutate(
       log2FC = log2(Fe / baseline_mean)
     )
   
 
   # 3. 构造 repeated sample ID
   #    假设 sample 名如 NC-1 / WT-2 / KO-3，且同一个 sample 在4个 step里一致
   
   plot_df <- plot_df %>%
     mutate(
       sample_id = sample
     )
   
   # 检查每个 sample 是否覆盖 4 个 step
   check_steps <- plot_df %>%
     group_by(sample_id) %>%
     summarise(n_stage = n_distinct(stage), .groups = "drop")
   
   print(check_steps)
   
   
   # 4. LMM
  
   m1 <- lmer(log2FC ~ group * stage + (1 | sample_id), data = plot_df)
   
   summary(m1)
   anova(m1)
   
   # 导出 ANOVA 表
   anova_tbl <- as.data.frame(anova(m1))
   anova_tbl$term <- rownames(anova_tbl)
   rownames(anova_tbl) <- NULL
   print(anova_tbl)
   
   write.table(
     anova_tbl,
     file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "ACBD", "LMM_log2FC_ANOVA.txt"),
     sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
   )
   
 
   # 5. 事后比较
   #    (a) 每个 stage 内比较 group
 
   emm_stage_group <- emmeans(m1, ~ group | stage)
   pair_stage_group <- contrast(emm_stage_group, method = "pairwise")
   
   print(emm_stage_group)
   print(pair_stage_group)
   
   write.table(
     as.data.frame(pair_stage_group),
     file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "ACBD", "LMM_pairwise_group_within_stage.txt"),
     sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
   )
   
   
   #    (b) 每个 group 内比较 stage

   emm_group_stage <- emmeans(m1, ~ stage | group)
   pair_group_stage <- contrast(emm_group_stage, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
   
   print(emm_group_stage)
   print(pair_group_stage)
   
   write.table(
     as.data.frame(pair_group_stage),
     file.path(data_dir, "Desktop", "replot", "culture", "field-experiment", "ACBD", "LMM_pairwise_stage_within_group.txt"),
     sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
   )

   data <- read.delim(

   # 1. 因子顺序
  
   data$stage <- factor(
     data$stage,

   )
   
   data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS"))
   data$day   <- as.numeric(data$day)
   data$Fe    <- as.numeric(data$Fe)
   
   
   # 2. 计算每个 step 的 baseline
   #    默认用 mean
   
   baseline_df <- data %>%
     filter(day == 0) %>%
     group_by(stage) %>%
     summarise(
       baseline_mean = mean(Fe, na.rm = TRUE),
       .groups = "drop"
     )
   
  
   # 3. 只保留 84 d，并计算 FC / log2FC
  
   fc_df <- data %>%
     filter(day == 84) %>%
     left_join(baseline_df, by = "stage") %>%
     mutate(
       FC = Fe / baseline_mean,
       log2FC = log2(Fe / baseline_mean)
     )
   
   print(fc_df)
   
   # 4. 每个 step 做 KW + Dunn
   #    这里以 log2FC 为例
   #    如果你想直接用 FC，把 log2FC 改成 FC 即可
  
   kw_res_list <- list()
   dunn_res_list <- list()
   letters_list <- list()
   
   for (st in levels(fc_df$stage)) {
     
     df_sub <- fc_df %>% filter(stage == st)
     
     # KW
     kw_res <- kruskal.test(log2FC ~ group, data = df_sub)
     kw_res_list[[st]] <- kw_res
     
     # Dunn
     dunn_res <- dunnTest(log2FC ~ group, data = df_sub, method = "bh")
     dunn_res_list[[st]] <- dunn_res
     
     dunn_tbl <- dunn_res$res
     
     # 生成字母分组
     comps <- gsub(" - ", "-", dunn_tbl$Comparison)
     pvals <- dunn_tbl$P.adj
     names(pvals) <- comps
     
     let <- multcompLetters(pvals)$Letters
     
     letters_df <- data.frame(
       stage = st,
       group = names(let),
       letter = let,
       stringsAsFactors = FALSE
     )
     
     letters_list[[st]] <- letters_df
   }
   
   letters_df_all <- bind_rows(letters_list)
   
   
   # 5. 汇总 KW 结果
   
   kw_summary <- data.frame(
     stage = names(kw_res_list),
     statistic = sapply(kw_res_list, function(x) unname(x$statistic)),
     p_value = sapply(kw_res_list, function(x) x$p.value)
   )
   
   print(kw_summary)
   print(letters_df_all)
   
   
   # 6. 查看每个 step 的 Dunn 详细结果
  
   for (st in names(dunn_res_list)) {
     cat("\n====================\n")
     cat(st, "\n")
     print(dunn_res_list[[st]]$res)
   }
```
